newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle sell $63, thin volume - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle sell $63, thin volume - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow, with few sales slaughter steers and heifers steady, USDA said.
Inquiry was moderate and demand rather light.

Sales confirmed on 700 slaughter steers and 800 slaughter heifers Wednesday. For the week to date 47,100 head confirmed including 13,800 head or about 29 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1125-1325 lbs 63.00. Slaughter heifers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1175 lbs 63.00.
